acceptanceCriteria: the #945 repro (require() entry) selects the spec passing its key or widens every caller with registry-key-unresolved; it never returns no test rows
a test reproduces the fail-open case on BASE and passes after the fix; one mutation restoring the fail-open path fails it
non-go-impact-v0 states the rule and the issue is closed with the fixing PR
body: GitHub #945 (owner, build main-253d634, rc.3). With --language-profile non-go-syntax-v0 and a declared string-key-registry/0 registry, a module reached only through require() inside a registry entry arrow gets only the path row and dynamic-dispatch-unresolved: no reverse-import, no test rows, no registry-key-unresolved. Selection fails open, contrary to NGI-V0-010; the dynamic import() form already fails closed (registry-key-unresolved, callers widened at 600). Expected: when a declared registry has any unresolved entry, registry-key-unresolved and the widening apply to every JS/TS changed path, as registry-export-unresolved already does; a require() inside an entry is a module reference the reverse-import rules can see. Repro fixture in the issue. Code: internal/contextindex/registry_dialect.go.
title: impact: registry module reached only by a lazy require() in an entry selects no tests and emits no registry-key-unresolved (GitHub #945)
